openclaw/openclaw.prepareCommand: corepack prepare pnpm@11.2.2 --activate && corepack pnpm config set store-dir /pnpm-store && corepack pnpm fetch --frozen-lockfile
openclaw/openclaw.runCommand: corepack pnpm config set store-dir /pnpm-store && corepack pnpm install --offline --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts && corepack pnpm exec vitest run {testFiles}
openclaw/openclaw.fallbackRunCommand: corepack pnpm config set store-dir /pnpm-store && corepack pnpm install --offline --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts && corepack pnpm test
